lines: Saves Str +6, Dex +4. Skills Athletics +6, Perception +4, Stealth +4, Survival +6. Senses: darkvision 60 ft.. Languages: Celestial, Common. Passive Perception 14.

sections.title: Traits
lines: Portal Sense. Detect any portal within 30 ft., even if inactive, and know where it leads. The wanderer also knows the distance and direction of the last portal it used while on the same plane as that portal.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Barbed Javelin or Shortbow attacks.
Barbed Javelin. Melee or ranged attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing. A creature hit loses 10 ft. of speed until the start of the wanderer's next turn.
Ram. Melee attack +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning. Moving straight toward the target for at least 20 ft. immediately before the hit adds 10 (3d6) bludgeoning and forces a DC 14 Strength save to avoid falling Prone.
Shortbow. Ranged attack +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing, plus 4 (1d8) piercing if the target is below maximum HP.

sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider native to Ysgard. It gains the Extraplanar subtype away from Ysgard. Racial adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft. and darkvision 60 ft.
Quadruped. +4 on checks to resist bull rush and trip, and 1½ times the normal carrying capacity for the Bariaur’s Strength. Bariaurs wear barding and cannot wear humanoid boots.

Powerful Charge. On a charge a Bariaur can make a single ram attack for 2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1½ times its Strength modifier. Apply the normal charge rules. The trait only grants the ram during a charge.
Spell resistance equals 11 + class level. Bariaurs have a +2 racial bonus on Will saves against spells and spell-like abilities and a +2 racial bonus on Listen and Spot checks.
Celestial and Common are automatic. Abyssal and Infernal are bonus languages. Favored class Ranger. LA +1. The playable profile specifies no racial Hit Dice.
Page 8 identifies the larger Bariaurs in Book of Exalted Deeds as Exalted Bariaurs.

Hook. Mara traced the rider as far as the bend above the ford.

AC 15 · HP 10 (1d8+2) · Speed 40 ft.

lines: Stoneford guard and Fighter.
Motive. Get the flock and its handlers over the ford before reopening the road.
Hook. Kel needs someone to guide the last animals while he guards the crossing.
